prompt:
Design an L-bracket in this project as the part `bracket`.

The bracket is a 60 mm (X) by 40 mm (Y) base plate, 6 mm thick, lying on the XY plane with its footprint centred on the origin and its underside at z = 0. Along the base plate's -Y edge stands a 6 mm thick wall of the same 60 mm length; the wall rises so the bracket's overall height is 40 mm. Blend the inner corner where the wall meets the top of the base plate with a 4 mm radius fillet.

Drill two 6 mm diameter through-holes in the base plate. Their centres are 12 mm in from each end of the plate (12 mm from the -X end and 12 mm from the +X end) and 14 mm in from the plate's +Y edge.

The project's `globals.py` already carries the plate thickness and the bracket envelope: read them through `hc` instead of repeating the numbers. The project also contains an inspection gauge part (`hole_gauge`) whose go-pins the acceptance checks fit through your holes - leave it exactly as it is.

Name the part `bracket`, build it, and export it as STEP when the geometry is right.
notes: Difficulty 1. Checks: envelope window, exact material volume (fillet + hole diameters), go-pin gauge fit (hole pattern), sealed with genus 2.
